subject: Intro & Demo: FinLytics (referred by Atlas SI)
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@atlas-si.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@atlas-si.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: FinLytics (referred by Atlas SI)

Hi Jasmine,

Quick intro — I'm Sarah at Atlas SI. We just finished an initial discovery with one of our mutual clients, FinLytics (cc'd: liam.brooks@finlytics.com). They have a clear need for lower-latency LLM inference for document ingestion and embedded search and asked for a short product demo to see how Redwood would fit into their architecture.

Quick background: FinLytics is a mid-market fintech analytics provider. Atlas recommended Redwood based on the predictable latency and private deployment options. They'd like an overview demo and to review integration points with our connectors.

Could you take this? Ideally a 30–45 min slot next week. I attached a one-page intro to Atlas->FinLytics context.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Partner Manager, Atlas SI
[Attachment: partner-referral-intro.pdf (1 page)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: FinLytics (referred by Atlas SI)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the intro, and hi Liam, great to meet you.

Camila (AE) and Dev (solutions) are copied — they'll join the demo. Happy to do a 30–45m walkthrough and tailor the agenda to integration points + performance/cost tradeoffs.

A few options next week from our side:
- Tue 3/30 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 3/31 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu 4/1 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, here's our quick Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30 — you can pick a slot and it'll auto-populate invites.

Proposed agenda: 1) Quick intros + use case, 2) 20m product demo focused on serving/runtime & integration, 3) Q&A and next steps (pricing/POC).

Attaching our demo slate for reference.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
